items.Sentence: The disinfected tertiary recycled water is continuously treated by microfiltration and reverse osmosis for refinery boiler feed, or by nitrification at the Carson WRP for refinery cooling towers.

The first treatment train produces approximately 5 MGD advanced -treated recycled water by treating disinfected tertiary recycled water from the ECLWRF with microfiltration (MF), reverse osmosis (RO), and decarbonation.

The second treatment train produces approximately 1.25 MGD nitrified recycled water by treating disinfected tertiary recycled water from ECLWRF by using nitrification in a Biofor® biofiltration system and break-point chlorination.
